tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Who looks after your cat when you travel?" Add do, does or did, or the -s, where you need it.
B builds the answer from the tiles. The blue tile is a verb with its preposition (wait for). Put the verb into the right form (waited for, waits for) and keep the preposition with it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.
